name: Ronnie Mabra
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: University of Georgia School of Law
about: Based in Atlanta, Georgia, Ronnie Mabra is the esteemed attorney and founder of The Mabra Law Firm. With unparalleled proficiency in personal injury law, he focuses on car accidents. His clients, spread across Georgia with a significant presence in the Atlanta metro, highly value his services. Renowned for his charismatic and affable demeanor, he is widely recognized amongst his colleagues and clientele as a legal professional of unwavering principles, an unrelenting work ethic and an unshakeable conviction to champion the cause of wronged plaintiffs and their kin.

Mr. Mabra has exhibited exceptional legal prowess by successfully procuring millions of dollars in compensation for injured individuals throughout Georgia. His exemplary skills were particularly evident when he served as a co-counsel in obtaining a $675 million settlement for NFL players with compensatory claims. His meritorious achievements have also earned him a place on the National Bar Association ‘40 Under 40’, the Atlanta Business Chronicle ‘40 Under 40’, the Fulton County Daily Report ‘On the Rise Under 40’ and the University of Georgia ‘40 Under 40’ lists.

Hailing from Georgia, Mr. Mabra achieved his academic feat at the renowned Georgia Institute of Technology, where he graduated with a B.S. in 2000. He then pursued his passion for law, and in 2004, he obtained his J.D. from the Georgia School of Law, earning him admission to practice law in Georgia that same year and in Florida in 2006. He was also admitted before the Georgia Court of Appeals, the Supreme Court of Georgia and the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia to further his capability. Ronnie is also a member of K appa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Inc.

In addition to his legal practice, Mr. Mabra is an active member of Leadership Georgia, the American Bar Association, the National Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association and the Gate City Bar Association.

A former distinguished Georgia House of Representatives member, Mr. Mabra left an indelible imprint in the state's political arena. Elected to the Georgia General Assembly twice, he fearlessly advocated for the interests of over 50,000 Georgians, speaking truth to power. Among his notable legislative triumphs is House Bill 828, a groundbreaking legislation that expanded protection for accident victims by confining the release of their confidential information.

Mr. Mabra's exceptional leadership qualities made him an invaluable Juvenile Justice State Advisory Group member, the Georgia Child Support Commission and the High School Athletics Overview Committee. Moreover, he served as House Democratic Caucus Deputy Whip. He was acknowledged as Lawmaker of the Year by the food worker's union, a well-deserved honor for his tireless efforts and exceptional contributions to society.
